capital.evidence_quote: Vaduz is the capital of the Principality of Liechtenstein and the seat of the national parliament

currency.evidence_quote: The Swiss Franc (CHF) is the official legal tender in Liechtenstein under the 1924 customs union treaty

timezone.evidence_quote: Liechtenstein observes Central European Time UTC+1 and Central European Summer Time UTC+2

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage in Liechtenstein is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The alternating electrical frequency is standardized at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Liechtenstein uses the Swiss Type J three-pin socket as well as Europlug Type C plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 117 for emergency national police services in Liechtenstein

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 144 for emergency ambulance and medical rescue services

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 118 for fire brigades and technical rescue across Liechtenstein

general.evidence_quote: 112 operates as the universal European emergency number

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Lihtenştayn dünyanın en güvenli ve müreffeh ülkelerindendir; olağan seyahat tedbirleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Liechtenstein is one of the safest countries in the world; exercise normal travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Liechtenstein ist eines der sichersten Länder weltweit; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Лихтенштейн — одна из самых безопасных стран мира; действуют обычные меры предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Liechtenstein es uno de los países más seguros del mundo; aplican precauciones normales de viaje.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Liechtenstein reach approximately 118.6 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Telecom Liechtenstein (FL1) operates high-speed 5G. Swiss mobile networks (Swisscom, Sunrise) provide comprehensive coverage with zero roaming fees across the principality.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Liechtenstein is fully integrated with Swiss cellular telecom networks

tr.conditions: Lihtenştayn Schengen bölgesi ve İsviçre gümrük birliği üyesidir. Türkiye umuma mahsus pasaport hamilleri Schengen vizesine tabidir. Hususi (Yeşil), Hizmet (Gri) ve Diplomatik pasaport hamilleri 180 günde 90 gün vizeden muaftır.

us.conditions: US citizens can enter Liechtenstein visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period under Schengen regulations.

de.conditions: German and EEA citizens enjoy freedom of movement and enter Liechtenstein with a valid national ID card or passport.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can visit Liechtenstein and the Schengen area visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day window.

ru.conditions: Гражданам РФ для посещения Лихтенштейна требуется краткосрочная шенгенская виза категории C.

dos.title: Use Swiss Francs (CHF) for daily cash
dos.description: The Swiss Franc is the official legal currency; Euros are accepted in most tourist shops with change given in CHF.

dos.title: Get a souvenir passport stamp at the Center
dos.description: Visit the Liechtenstein Center in downtown Vaduz to receive an official souvenir passport stamp for 3 CHF.

dos.title: Hike the scenic Rhine Valley and Alps
dos.description: Explore the Liechtenstein Trail linking medieval Gutenberg Castle, Vaduz Castle viewpoints, and Malbun ski peaks.

donts.title: Don't approach Vaduz Castle private quarters
donts.description: Vaduz Castle is the active private residence of the Princely Family; admire the castle from exterior viewpoints.

donts.title: Don't make noise during midday rest (Mittagsruhe)
donts.description: Liechtenstein observes quiet hours between 12:00 and 13:30; loud commercial noise or lawnmowers are discouraged.

etiquette.tipping: Service is included by law in all bills; rounding up to the nearest franc or leaving 5-10% is customary for great service.
